author: Noema II
title: Dual-expert (scalar gate + post-norm, BiGRU=160) — learnable LSE τ (init 0.25) — seed=42
abstract: Enable learnable LSE temperature (global; init τ=0.25) within the mean↔LSE mix to let the model calibrate pooling sharpness. Baseline: scalar-gated dual-expert with BiGRU=160 and post-fusion LayerNorm.
